ayahs.translation_bn: শপথ সেই (ঘোড়া) গুলোর যারা ঊর্ধ্বশ্বাসে দৌড়ায়,
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-د-و ('-d-w): rapid sprinting; ض-ب-ح (ḍ-b-ḥ): pulmonary panting under kinetic exertion.
ayahs.conventional_bn: শপথ সেই (ঘোড়া) গুলোর যারা ঊর্ধ্বশ্বাসে দৌড়ায়,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-د-و ('-d-w): rapid sprinting; ض-ب-ح (ḍ-b-ḥ): pulmonary panting under kinetic exertion.

english_translations.yusuf_ali: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
english_translations.shakir: I swear by the runners breathing pantingly,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (I swear) by the snorting chargers (of the warriors), whose hoofs strike against the rocks
english_translations.mohsin_khan: By the (steeds) that run, with panting (breath),

ayahs.translation_en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
ayahs.conventional_en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root و-ر-ي (w-r-y): producing fire; ق-د-ح (q-d-ḥ): frictional kinetic impact generating thermal sparks.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root و-ر-ي (w-r-y): producing fire; ق-د-ح (q-d-ḥ): frictional kinetic impact generating thermal sparks.

english_translations.sahih_international: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
english_translations.shakir: Then those that produce fire striking,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves),

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root غ-و-ر (gh-w-r): dynamic tactical charge in diurnal transition.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root غ-و-ر (gh-w-r): dynamic tactical charge in diurnal transition.

english_translations.pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And push home the charge in the morning,
english_translations.shakir: Then those that make raids at morn,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: while running during a raid at dawn,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And scouring to the raid at dawn

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ق-ع (n-q-'): aerodynamic dust vortex raised by sudden rapid acceleration.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ق-ع (n-q-'): aerodynamic dust vortex raised by sudden rapid acceleration.

english_translations.pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and leave behind a cloud of dust
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর (শত্রু) দলের অভ্যন্তরে ঢুকে পড়ে (এভাবে মানুষ নিজের শক্তি-সামর্থ্য ও আল্লাহর এক অতি বড় নি‘মাত ঘোড়াকে অপরের সম্পদ লুণ্ঠন ও অন্যের প্রতি যুলমের কাজে ব্যবহার করে),
ayahs.translation_en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
ayahs.conventional_en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ও-س-ط (w-s-ṭ): breaching defensive perimeters to strike the structural core.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতঃপর (শত্রু) দলের অভ্যন্তরে ঢুকে পড়ে (এভাবে মানুষ নিজের শক্তি-সামর্থ্য ও আল্লাহর এক অতি বড় নি‘মাত ঘোড়াকে অপরের সম্পদ লুণ্ঠন ও অন্যের প্রতি যুলমের কাজে ব্যবহার করে),

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ও-س-ط (w-s-ṭ): breaching defensive perimeters to strike the structural core.

english_translations.sahih_international: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
english_translations.pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
english_translations.shakir: Then rush thereby upon an assembly:
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe);

ayahs.translation_bn: বস্তুতঃ মানুষ তার রব-এর প্রতি বড়ই অকৃতজ্ঞ।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ك-ن-দ (k-n-d): obstinate ingratitude, enumerating afflictions while concealing endless bounties.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বস্তুতঃ মানুষ তার রব-এর প্রতি বড়ই অকৃতজ্ঞ।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ك-ن-দ (k-n-d): obstinate ingratitude, enumerating afflictions while concealing endless bounties.

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
english_translations.shakir: Most surely man is ungrateful to his Lord.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The human being is certainly ungrateful to his Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily! Man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord;
english_translations.arberry: Surely Man is ungrateful to his Lord,

ayahs.translation_bn: আর সে নিজেই (নিজের কাজ-কর্মের মাধ্যমে) এ বিষয়ের সাক্ষী।
ayahs.translation_en: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
ayahs.conventional_en: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Behavioral evidence acting as self-indicting testimony.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর সে নিজেই (নিজের কাজ-কর্মের মাধ্যমে) এ বিষয়ের সাক্ষী।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Behavioral evidence acting as self-indicting testimony.

english_translations.sahih_international: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
english_translations.pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
english_translations.shakir: And most surely he is a witness of that.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He himself knows this very well.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And to that fact he bears witness (by his deeds);
english_translations.arberry: and surely he is a witness against that!

ayahs.translation_bn: আর ধন-সম্পদের প্রতি অবশ্যই সে খুবই আসক্ত।
ayahs.translation_en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
ayahs.conventional_en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ش-দ-দ (sh-d-d): excessive grip, hyper-attachment to financial accumulation.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর ধন-সম্পদের প্রতি অবশ্যই সে খুবই আসক্ত।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ش-দ-দ (sh-d-d): excessive grip, hyper-attachment to financial accumulation.

english_translations.sahih_international: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
english_translations.pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
english_translations.shakir: And most surely he is tenacious in the love of wealth.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He certainly has a strong love for wealth and riches.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.
english_translations.arberry: Surely he is passionate in his love for good things.

ayahs.transliteration: afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūri
ayahs.translation_bn: সে কি জানে না, কবরে যা আছে তা যখন উত্থিত হবে,
ayahs.translation_en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.conventional_en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ب-ع-ث-ر (b-'-th-r): overturning matter to reveal somatic remnants.
ayahs.conventional_bn: সে কি জানে না, কবরে যা আছে তা যখন উত্থিত হবে,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ب-ع-ث-ر (b-'-th-r): overturning matter to reveal somatic remnants.

english_translations.sahih_international: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
english_translations.pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
english_translations.shakir: Does he not then know when what is in the graves is raised,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Does he not know that on the day when those in the graves are resurrected
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are brought out and poured forth (all mankind is resurrected).
english_translations.arberry: Knows he not that when that which is in the tombs is over-thrown,

ayahs.translation_bn: আর অন্তরে যা (কিছু লুকানো) আছে তা প্রকাশ করা হবে,
ayahs.translation_en: And that within the breasts is obtained,
ayahs.conventional_en: And that within the breasts is obtained,
ayahs.meta_bn: কোর মেমোরি আনলকিং ও ফাইল ডিক্রিপশন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ح-ص-ল (ḥ-ṣ-l): harvesting, distilling, extracting internal cognitive data.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর অন্তরে যা (কিছু লুকানো) আছে তা প্রকাশ করা হবে,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ح-ص-ল (ḥ-ṣ-l): harvesting, distilling, extracting internal cognitive data.

english_translations.sahih_international: And that within the breasts is obtained,
english_translations.pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
english_translations.shakir: And what is in the breasts is made apparent?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and all that is in the hearts is made public,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And that which is in the breasts (of men) shall be made known.
english_translations.arberry: and that which is in the breasts is brought out --

ayahs.translation_bn: নিঃসন্দেহে তাদের প্রতিপালক সেদিন তাদের সম্পর্কে পুরোপুরি অবহিত থাকবেন।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
ayahs.meta_bn: রিয়াল-টাইম ক্লাউড অডিট ও জিরো-ল্যাগিং স্ক্যান
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root خ-ب-ر (kh-b-r): exhaustive quantum and biographical knowledge.
ayahs.conventional_bn: নিঃসন্দেহে তাদের প্রতিপালক সেদিন তাদের সম্পর্কে পুরোপুরি অবহিত থাকবেন।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root خ-ب-ر (kh-b-r): exhaustive quantum and biographical knowledge.

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
english_translations.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
english_translations.shakir: Most surely their Lord that day shall be fully aware of them.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: their Lord will examine his deeds?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds), (and will reward them for their deeds).
english_translations.arberry: surely on that day their Lord shall be aware of them!
